# VCS {.unnumbered}

A practical library for **version control**, starting with **Git** and the forges and workflows built around it.

```text
VCS
└── Git
    ├── Intro & cheatsheet
    ├── Fundamentals → remotes
    ├── GitHub, Actions, collaboration
    └── Misc (GitLab, Gitea, Jujutsu, …)
```

## How to use

1. Expand **Git** in the sidebar and open a topic section.  
2. Work front-to-back for a full course, or jump to a single chapter.  
3. Use search when you already know the command or feature name.

## Formats

HTML, PDF, and EPUB when built via the monorepo portal.
